name: Nintendo Switch House
description: A minecraft house shaped like a Nintendo Switch, laid flat with a blue and a red controller on each side. The screen opens into one furnished room with a bed, chests and a furnace. Mostly concrete and wool. Fun centerpiece for a themed world.

subBuilds.description: Break 4 blocks like this.
Dig 1 block more.
Place the leather cap on the armor stand.
Place the wool 1 block higher than the armor stand.
Place a redstone block in the center of the piston.
Place any block under the piston.
Place the redstone block at the center of the piston again.
Break everything like the pistons and extra blocks.
Do the same thing on the other side.
Place a redstone block behind the piston and break everything related to the piston and redstone block.
Come this way.
Break blocks like this and dig 1 block extra.
Place the leather cap on the armor stand.
Place the wool 1 block higher than the armor stand.
Repeat the same steps as before.
Place any block under the piston and place a redstone block in the middle.
Place a redstone block behind the piston and break everything related to the piston and redstone block.
Dig down four blocks.
Break some blocks.
Place your armor on the armor stand.
